lastCompletedStory.title: Isolate test/supervisor/loop.test.ts onto a generic claude fixture config

nextStoryContext:
US-003 (CAM-420) threaded RunSupervisorOptions.configPath (already present since US-001 of this PRD) into loop.test.ts's makeBaseOpts factory via a new module-level GENERIC_SUPERVISOR_CONFIG_PATH fixture (mkdtempSync tmpdir, '[backend]
implementer = "claude"
', afterAll cleanup), defaulted AFTER the '...overrides' spread with `'configPath' in overrides ? overrides.configPath : GENERIC_SUPERVISOR_CONFIG_PATH` (mirrors review.test.ts's GENERIC_REVIEW_CONFIG_PATH idiom from US-001, CAM-405). This decouples all ~120 generic runSupervisor tests in this file from the repo's live scripts/cam/project.toml backend declaration. 9 pre-existing chdir-based tests (3 via withClaudeImplementerCwd, 3 via withCodexBackendCwd, plus a container-mode describe block's 2 tests and one raw inline process.chdir test predating both named helpers) needed an explicit `configPath: undefined` sibling key added directly to their makeBaseOpts({...}) call (NOT inherited from a spread like ...oneStoryBase()) to keep exercising real cwd-relative resolution against their own staged fixture on purpose. Two stale comments claiming readPhaseBackend/readPhaseModel were 'not injectable through RunSupervisorOptions' (loop.test.ts, pre-US-003 lines 539 and 4246) were rewritten to say 'fixture-injectable via RunSupervisorOptions.configPath (CAM-420)', since that claim became false once US-001 of this PRD added the configPath field (the comments had gone stale one story early). Verification: `bun test test/supervisor/loop.test.ts` is 170 pass / 0 fail locally; full `bun test` is 5633 pass / 0 fail; `bun run check:all` green after raising test/supervisor/loop.test.ts's file-size-budget.json ceiling from 4999 to 5048 (exact `content.split('
').length` count) with a dated _ref note. Dress rehearsal (issue AC4, run per the PRD's exact recipe against a git worktree of the committed HEAD, with the worktree's project.toml patched to implementer='codex', bun install --frozen-lockfile with the real HOME, then bun test with an emptied HOME): dropped from the documented baseline of 85 fails (74 of them in loop.test.ts) to EXACTLY 11 fails / 0 in loop.test.ts, matching the PRD's predicted residual distribution byte-for-byte: events.test.ts 3 (worker-start->worker-end->result->tokens lifecycle, handoff-schema-warning, no-events-when-logEvent-absent), ensure-worker-pane.test.ts 3 (all 3 'implement branch' respawn-pane-targeting tests), a spawn-resolution-event-persistence describe block 2 (uuid-matching, no-event-when-logEvent-absent), pause-halt (CAM-360 cooperative pause brake) 1, a resolvePhaseModel-wired-into-implementer-dispatch AC4 test 1 ('claude-backed dispatch never invokes the injected cacheReader'), and pause-resume (CAM-360 resume-after-pause) 1. Every one of these 6 residual files still resolves the implementer backend via real cwd-relative project.toml reads with NO configPath override in their own makeBaseOpts-equivalent factories -- they are legitimate, documented, deliberately out-of-scope follow-up candidates for a future story if the codex-unauthenticated-CI-runner problem needs to be fully eliminated project-wide, not just for loop.test.ts. Any future story touching one of those 6 files should apply the identical configPath-fixture-isolation idiom (see patterns.md's new CAM-420 US-003 bullet) rather than re-deriving it from scratch.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure test-fixture DI-isolation story: no new external library surface introduced. RunSupervisorOptions.configPath already existed (US-001 of this PRD, src/supervisor/loop.ts) and was already threaded into readPhaseBackend/resolvePhaseModel; this story only wired the pre-existing seam into loop.test.ts's test-fixture factory, mirroring the already-shipped review.test.ts (US-001, CAM-405) idiom.
